ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 65:35 high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white fields located on the distal portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is concentrated at the central base (peduncle attachment), along the entire trailing edge, and within a distinct intersecting linear 'X' pattern on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an estimated pixel angle of 130 degrees; depth is partially obscured by water turbulence at the baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with high-frequency pixel-amplitude spikes at the distal tips; moderate, low-amplitude wave-like variations along the central trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge trajectory sweeping laterally and upward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, irregular clusters of raised, textured pixels (calcification/barnacles) concentrated heavily on the extreme tips of both lobes; scattered dark focal spots on the white field of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions intersecting to form an 'X' shape on the mid-distal region of the left lobe; additional faint horizontal linear marks on the outer right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization/calcification on both lobe tips and a distinct 'X' shaped traumatic scar or pigment disruption on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The intersecting 'X' shaped dark mark on the left lobe provides a highly unique spatial signature not found on the right lobe.
